user_text: Hi, I'm here on a school trip with my class. Can you show me a painting with many colors?

robot_messages.main: You will love "Water Lilies" by Claude Monet! Look at all those water flowers! Monet painted this pond over and over because he loved how the light changed the colors every day. Can you see the reflections in the water? He used soft blues, greens, and violets to make the scene feel dreamy and calm. You can find this painting to the left of "Las Meninas."
robot_messages.follow_up: Did you like the colors in Water Lilies, or would you like to see another painting?
